fichas.title: Accessible movement areas
fichas.summary: Movement areas for wheelchair users are specified for turning, routes, approaches to facilities and equipment, door operation, and other public-building situations.

dimensions.label: Movement area width and depth
dimensions.context: Minimum width and depth for turning areas, at ramp ends, and in front of listed equipment and service points.
dimensions.ocr_raw: min. 1.50 m wide and min. 1.50 m deep ...

dimensions.label: Movement area width
dimensions.context: Minimum width in corridors, main routes, and next to stairs going up and down.
dimensions.ocr_raw: min. 1.50 m wide ...

dimensions.label: Movement area depth
dimensions.context: Minimum depth in front of therapy facilities and wheelchair parking places, and next to the long side of a wheelchair user's vehicle in car parks.
dimensions.ocr_raw: min. 1.50 m deep ...

dimensions.label: Movement area width
dimensions.context: Minimum width alongside facilities approached from the side, between ramp wheel kerbs, and next to operated equipment.
dimensions.ocr_raw: min. 1.20 m wide ...

dimensions.label: Movement area width
dimensions.context: Minimum width in access ways next to cash desks and checkpoints and on side routes.
dimensions.ocr_raw: min. 0.90 m wide ...

fichas.title: Accessible routes, lifts, ramps, and stairs
fichas.summary: Accessible buildings must connect all levels without steps, using a lift or ramp. The page specifies lift-car clear dimensions, ramp slopes and fittings, and movement areas next to stairs.
spaces: Areas in front of lift doors
uses: Wheelchair movement on ramps and at stairs

dimensions.label: Lift-car clear width
dimensions.context: Minimum clear width of the lift car.
dimensions.ocr_raw: min. clear width of 1.10 m

dimensions.label: Lift-car clear depth
dimensions.context: Clear depth of the lift car.
dimensions.ocr_raw: a clear depth of 1.40 m

dimensions.label: Movement area in front of lift doors
dimensions.context: Minimum width and minimum depth; the area must be as large as the lift-car floor area and must not overlap other traffic routes or movement areas.
dimensions.ocr_raw: min. 1.50 m wide and 1.50 m deep

dimensions.label: Maximum ramp slope
dimensions.context: Maximum slope permitted for ramps.
dimensions.ocr_raw: May have a maximum slope of 6%

dimensions.label: Ramp length threshold
dimensions.context: An intermediate landing is required when a ramp is longer than this length.
dimensions.ocr_raw: If ramps are longer than 6 m

dimensions.label: Intermediate landing length
dimensions.context: Minimum length of the intermediate landing for a ramp longer than 6 m.
dimensions.ocr_raw: an intermediate landing of min. 1.50 m length is required.

dimensions.label: Wheel-kerb height
dimensions.context: Height of wheel kerbs on the ramp and intermediate landing.
dimensions.ocr_raw: with 10 cm high wheel kerbs

dimensions.label: Handrail diameter
dimensions.context: Handrail diameter range.
dimensions.ocr_raw: handrails (diameter 3-4.5 cm)

dimensions.label: Handrail height
dimensions.context: Height of handrails on ramps and intermediate landings.
dimensions.ocr_raw: at a height of 85 cm

dimensions.label: Clear ramp width
dimensions.context: Minimum clear width of the ramp.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The clear ramp width must be min. 1.20 m.

dimensions.label: Horizontal projection into platform area
dimensions.context: Wheel kerbs and handrails must project this distance horizontally into the platform area.
dimensions.ocr_raw: must project 30 cm horizontally into the platform area.

dimensions.label: Movement area next to stairs
dimensions.context: Minimum width next to stairs going up and down; the tread of the first step is excluded from the calculation.
dimensions.ocr_raw: must be min. 1.50 m wide

fichas.title: Doors and sanitary facilities
fichas.summary: Door clear passage width and opening direction are specified, along with the provision of wheelchair-accessible toilets and a recommended seat height.

dimensions.label: Clear passage width of doors
dimensions.context: Minimum clear passage width.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Clear passage width of doors ≥0.90 m

figure_refs: Figures 1 and 2: movement areas in front of hand-operated doors
Figure 8: overlapping of movement areas in sanitary facilities

fichas.title: Corridors, passing places, and wheelchair parking
fichas.summary: Long corridors and routes must include a passing place for two wheelchair users. The design must also provide a wheelchair parking place for each wheelchair user, preferably near the entrance.

dimensions.label: Route length threshold
dimensions.context: Corridors and routes longer than this length must have a passing place for two wheelchair users.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Corridors and routes longer than 15 m

dimensions.label: Passing place width and depth
dimensions.context: Minimum width and depth of a passing place for two wheelchair users.
dimensions.ocr_raw: at least 1.80 m width and depth
